lines.text: Anyone who disagrees with the sound words of Moses and with godly teaching is conceited and understands nothing.
Disputes about words produce envy, strife, abusive talk, and evil suspicions.
Godliness with contentment is great gain, for we brought nothing into the world and can carry nothing out.
If we have food and silver, we will be content with these.
Craving money, some have wandered away from the faith and pierced themselves with many sorrows.
